mobile.camera_error: Cannot open the camera — check the permission
mobile.delete_group_hint: The folder goes; what is inside it moves up one level.
mobile.lan_done: Both devices are linked — nothing to do on the other one.
mobile.lan_my_code: This device's code — a new one every minute
mobile.lan_not_found: No device answered. Check that both are on the same network and that the code is still the one shown.
mobile.lock_on_background: Lock when the app is left
mobile.lock_on_background_hint: Closes the vault as soon as you switch away, and keeps memos out of the app switcher. Leave it on unless you switch apps constantly.
mobile.no_devices: No devices yet. Scan the other device's QR, or type the code above on it.
mobile.pair_added: Added. Enter this device's code on the other device as well.
mobile.photo_missing: This photo has not arrived on this device yet
mobile.scan_hint: Point the camera at the other device's pairing QR
mobile.sync_unavailable: Sync is unavailable in this build
mobile.unlock_days_hint: Days the vault reopens without the password. 0 asks every time. While it lasts, the key is kept in this device's keystore — anyone who can unlock the phone can read the memos.
mobile.update_check_hint: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded or installed, and nothing about you or your memos is sent — but your address does reach GitHub.
msg.cache_open_failed: Failed to open the local cache: {error}
msg.lan_peer_not_found: No nearby device is using that code
msg.paired_enter_password: Connected to another device — enter the master password
msg.recovery_issued: A new recovery code was issued; the old one no longer works.
msg.register_done: Registered. Now register this code on the other device too.
msg.reset_done: Everything was deleted — create a new vault.
msg.settings_saved_relock: Saved. The auto-unlock period changed, so you will be asked for the password once on next launch.
msg.sync_off_cannot_register: Sync is off, so nothing can be registered
msg.unshare_before_reset: Nothing was deleted: the shared folder could not be released
ui.list_empty:
No memos yet. ＋ makes a memo, 📁 makes a group.
Drag a memo onto a group to put it inside.
ui.lock_code_warning: This is the only way back to your memos if you forget the password. You will not see it again, so keep it somewhere safe — anyone holding it can open your memos.
ui.lock_no_recovery: This vault has no recovery code. Without the password the memos cannot be opened.
ui.lock_recovery_prompt: Enter your recovery code and choose a new password.
ui.lock_reset_hint: The button below deletes this device's memos and vault and starts over. It also unlinks the other devices, and cannot be undone.
ui.lock_start_hint: To share memos with another device, choose 'Connect' and pair first. Creating a new vault first gives each device a different key, so they will never sync.
ui.pair_lan_hint:
① Enter the 6 digits below on your other device, or
② type that device's 6 digits here.
ui.pair_remote_hint:
On a different network? Share the QR or the code below,
then enter their code to register.
ui.pair_unavailable: Sync is off — syncthing was not found.
ui.security_code_warning: Write it down now — it cannot be shown again once this window closes.
ui.security_mismatch: The new passwords do not match
ui.security_password_hint: Instant, because no memo is re-encrypted. The other devices ask for the new password the next time they unlock.
ui.security_recovery_absent: No recovery code yet — issue one now.
ui.security_recovery_hint: The only way into the vault if the password is lost. Issuing a new one retires the old code.
ui.settings_idle_minutes_hint: 0 = off. Locks after this long without interacting with the app.
ui.settings_merge_seconds_hint: How often to pull in changes from other devices. Shorter is faster but reads the disk more.
ui.settings_unlock_days_hint: 0 = ask for the password every launch. Any higher value keeps the vault openable without the password for that long, which requires caching the key on this device — so anyone who can read the disk can read your memos until it expires.
ui.settings_update_check_hint: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded or installed, and nothing about you or your memos is sent — but your address does reach GitHub, so this can be turned off.
ui.sticky_photo_missing: This photo has not arrived on this device yet
